name: Adjoint Method > Gradient w.r.t Ray Direction
aliases: Gradient of Projection Weight w.r.t Ray Direction
definition: Computes the gradient of the projection weight P with respect to the ray direction n, i.e., $\partial P / \partial n_{idx}$. Accounts for implicit dependence of entry point $p_a$ on n.
summary: This method computes exact geometric gradients of projection weight with respect to ray direction by accounting for the implicit dependence of the entry point on the direction, unlike the Inversion Trick which may approximate these sensitivities.
